From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC closeout: 6-week pilot recap & short testimonial request

Hi Ana / Liam —

Congratulations again on closing the 6-week pilot with the latency-sensitive recommendation workload. We pulled together the end-of-pilot metrics and a very short summary attached: marketgrid_poc_kpis.csv. Highlights: 
- 42% reduction in 99th-percentile inference latency after prefix-KV caching and model routing tweaks (baseline 420ms -> 244ms)
- Token cost per inference down 36% via batching + quantization profile (NVIDIA A10x2)
- Throughput sustained at 320 qps during peak synthetic load; no SLA misses across two regional runs

Thank you for the constructive feedback during the pilot — you pushed us to tighten warmup behavior which helped reliability.

Quick ask: would MarketGrid be open to a brief 10–15 minute recorded call or a one-paragraph quote we can use as a short reference? Example uses: a one-liner for our case-study landing page and a 10–15 minute recorded snippet for a short customer highlight. We’d keep the ask minimal: one metric line and a single sentence about impact is enough.

If you’re comfortable, please reply with either: (A) a short quote in the body of your reply, or (B) availability for a 15-minute call next week and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached the KPI CSV and the signed MOU for your records.

Attachments: [marketgrid_poc_kpis.csv (csv, 38KB)], [signed-mou.pdf (pdf, 212KB)]

Thanks — really appreciate the partnership.

—Sergio
